title: First-visit dialog
summary: On the first visit a "Jak hrát" dialog explains the game in three lines, each with a board-style tile: one word (PIVO tile), the blue "?" key for clues and their cost, five lives and scoring. "Hrát" closes it for good; a "Jak hrát" link in the header reopens it on game pages.
tradeoffs: Interrupts the very first visit with a modal before the player sees the board; returning players never see it again (stored in localStorage, so private-mode visitors see it each time).
